description: September 19 birthday meaning: Virgo decan 3, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a September 19 birthday falls in Virgo, in the third decan, with Mercury as the sign's ruler and Venus as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Virgo is mutable and earth.

sections.heading: Personality of a September 19 birthday
paragraphs: Late-Virgo independence shows up on September 19. Nineteen reduces to 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, and the Sun sits near twenty-six degrees of the sign, in a decan that Venus sub-rules. Interpretively, this mixes initiative with taste: someone inclined to start their own small venture, design it carefully and insist that it be useful as well as lovely.

By noon UTC on September 19, the Sun has normally reached roughly 26° of Virgo. That places the date in the Virgo decan that astrologers give to Venus, the third of three. Venus, ruler of Taurus, softens the last decan of Virgo, from roughly September 13 to September 22. The sign's practicality is joined by an eye for beauty, comfort and craft. Late-Virgo birthdays are often linked with gardening, design, cooking or any work where precision produces something pleasant to live with. Relationships may matter more than the classic Virgo stereotype suggests, and these natives tend to show love through thoughtful, tangible acts. Venus can encourage perfectionism about appearances too. Accepting that something can be lovely and unfinished at the same time usually brings this decan real ease.

sections.heading: Numerology of the September 19 birthday
paragraphs: Born on the 19th, the compound 1 + 9 makes 10, which reduces to 1. The birthday number is therefore 1, reached through the full span of the single digits from first to last. Numerologists sometimes call 19 a karmic debt number associated with learning to accept help. People born on this day are frequently described as fiercely independent, resourceful and determined to do things their own way. The 9 in the compound adds compassion and a broad outlook to the 1's drive. As a secondary number, it tends to reward asking for support without seeing it as weakness.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same September 19 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: September 19 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: A September birthday arrives at the turn into autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of new terms and gathering in, and at the start of spring in the southern. Virgo occupies most of the month, with Libra taking over around September 22 or 23, near the equinox. September is month 9 in numerology, the number of completion, compassion and a broad, humanitarian outlook. September 19 is the 262nd day of the year (263rd in a leap year). In most years Libra season is under way by September 23, 4 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a September 19 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. September 19 is also the birthday of William Golding (1911), Jeremy Irons (1948) and Masatoshi Koshiba (1926).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is September 19?
faq.answer: September 19 is Virgo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Virgo, which tradition links with Venus.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on September 19?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On September 19 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 19th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on September 19?
faq.answer: By September 19 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on September 19?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a September 19 birthday are William Golding (1911), Jeremy Irons (1948) and Masatoshi Koshiba (1926). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
